Name: Modest Maps Greenhouse
Author: InkubusMods
Description:
[b][size=3]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6[/size][/b]

REQUIRES:
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content patcher
[*]Yep. [i]That's all.[/i]
[/list]

OVERVIEW:
The Modest Greenhouse Map is a redesigned interior greenhouse, meant to capitalize on the space provided with the vanilla map, with a few tweaks here and there for added support.


The Greenhouse includes added perks and space.
[list]
[*]Slightly expanded plot to fit a perfect 3x3 Iridium sprinklers.
[*]Enough space to fit two of each fruit tree.
[/list]

SIDE NOTES:
[list]
[*]If you like my work or have found an issue, I'd love for you to let me know in the POSTS! This is the first mod I've ever posted to the nexus, or put so much effort into, so I'd appreciate the support!
[/list]
MANUAL INSTALLATION:
Download the file.
Extract the Folder.
Put said folder into:
﻿Steam>Steamapps>Common>StardewValley>Mods.
Load with SMAPI.
Enjoy.

Downloads.Description: Fixed issue with unplantable trees..... Hopefully.
